name: azure-game-studio-mcp
description: Multi-engine Game Development MCP Servers powered by Azure AI - Generate code for Blender, Unity, Flutter/Flame, and Figma
author: Azure Game Studio Contributors

scripts.build: bun build index.ts --target node --outfile dist/core.js && bun build servers/blender/index.ts --target node --outfile dist/blender.js && bun build servers/flame/index.ts --target node --outfile dist/flame.js && bun build servers/unity/index.ts --target node --outfile dist/unity.js && bun build servers/figma/index.ts --target node --outfile dist/figma.js
